about: How the crowd dresses the creatures: each enemy's and thrall's model, fallback, caster and hover looks, legion and thrall looks (the old game's entity views, as data). Colours are sRGB hex strings. client/crowd/README.md 'Driving the crowd'.
wobble_about: the old game's _fen_dead: the Mire Leech's slither (the root rolls and squashes with the clock and its id; a quarter as much standing still)
spectral_models_about: DmCreature's spectral bodies (the wraith enemy, the Mourner's thralls): see-through at 0.55, no depth write, no shadow
enemy_glow_about: the old game's _enemy_opts: [emissive sRGB hex, emissive_intensity]; an elite's overrides the rest; the risen in the Fen use risen_fen
thrall_props_about: the old game's _make_thrall: the props each kind holds (DmGearProps builder, its argument, the bone, DmCreature.attach's dir and follow). Warriors and shieldbearers only under an armed legion (or none); archers and bone mages always. Baked as '<model>+<kind>' variants.
kit_about: the Legion kit (the character's Legion slots 120 and 121, DmLegion.kit_pieces) the thralls of these kinds wear (the old game's KIT_BODIES): the armour piece's tier colour tints the chest and hands at armor_strength, its glow (x glow_k) lights the trim, the weapon piece's tier colour washes over the props marked kit (the sword's blade replaced, the bow's and staff's wood 0.3)
thrall_glow_about: the old game's _make_thrall: the look's or the legion's emissive and glow, else default; the wraith's own; + empowered (not the wraith) and + champion
thrall_rim_about: the old game's _make_thrall's friend rim (DmCreatureMat): the spirit ring's colour (SPELL_FX exhume.spirit, 0x6fe3c8) at THRALL_RIM_OWN for this player's thralls and THRALL_RIM_ALLY for another player's; a champion's is gold at 1.4
wings_about: the old game's WINGS by the model the def draws with (moth: shroud_moth, bat: tithe_bat, seraph: weeping_seraph); the unrigged baker writes the beat into a loop
